note: ADR-0005's artifact pins, transcribed. A pin is only usable with its content hash: the model is never committed (`.pre-commit-config.yaml` refuses files over 2 MB), so what the package carries is the hash and the acquisition procedure, not the bytes. `tokenizer.json` is a regular git blob rather than an LFS object, so the only content identity the Hub exposes for it is a SHA-1 git blob id — presenting that as a SHA-256 would be wrong, which is why the field has its own name.

pins.variant_note: All three files resolve to the same LFS object id, so one SHA-256 verifies all of them and choosing between them is not a kernel choice.
